_meta.utility_note: TSTR uses held-out matched conditions (transductive utility), not independent cohort TSTR

real_vs_synthetic.note: Held-out source classification on matched retained VAL cohorts; 0.5 means weak distinguishability for this classifier only, not proof of privacy or fidelity.

subgroup_fidelity.note: Marginal subgroups, not full joint profiles; privacy support is not a statistical stability guarantee.
